summary: Read NVFP4-CSF checkpoints in the Hugging Face layout, including their quantized vision towers
compatibility: No user action required. Checkpoints whose ModelOpt recipes declare weight_scale_encoding: csf load without a serving directory, checkpoint_root or --load-format; the lil-nvfp4-csf-checkpoint/1 container keeps working.
details: The checkpoint contract comes from model.safetensors.index.json: compressed routed-expert scales are .nvfp4_csf_fixed / .nvfp4_csf_exceptions streams in any checkpoint-local shard, and the model family follows from the compressed inventory.
Stored vision recipes apply: model.visual.* recipes resolve for the tower's modules, and GLM-5.3-Flash uses them instead of online MXFP8 (which stays the fallback for BF16 towers).

GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4-MXFP8-CSF-QAD@dec48abd and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4-MXFP8-CSF-QAD@dc5b8ab2 at TP2: KV 1,844,162 and 5,065,660 tokens, vision checks 11/11 and 10/11, no CJK leakage, decode steps/s C1 69.3 and 95.7 on RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q.
